themes: open pack (themes-open): neutral looks only, because this is a public site
notes: A static website (no app, no server, no Electron, no Android), so most modules do not apply and the ones that do are used in their plainest form. appearance: the site vendors themes-open/dist (base.css + engine.global.js) built locally from engine branch commit 42d3ea8 (the picker's themed drop-downs; CI rebuilds dist on main after that merges: re-vendor from main then and move `ref` to the merge commit) into site/vendor/turbothemes and starts it from site/assets/site.js; there is no React Layout/AppearanceCard, the engine's own <turbo-themes-picker> is the picker. Fonts are 'none' and updates are off (source: false) so the page makes no third-party request; to take newer themes, copy the two files again from a newer engine commit and update `ref`. motion: site/assets/motion.css is the engine's file unchanged (only tk-swap is used; tk-arrive animates max-height, so it is not used on big blocks). logos: branding/logo.json is the bare engine mark (no emblem); the six app icons under site/img/apps are copied from each app's own repo. release-pipeline: auto-pr.yml is the engine's with the PR text changed, release.yml is only its `release` job (tag vYYYY.M.N; Cloudflare Pages deploys main), check.yml is the site check and also runs on pull requests. guides-and-docs: no in-app guides (docs/guides is not used); docs/development has the rest.
